note: A grass pull-in in deep woods on Cole Run Road beside Camp Run, listed as 90 by 20 ft with 35 ft of overhead clearance. From PA 120 at the village of Cooks Run, take Cooks Run Road north-west about 1.1 miles, bear left to stay on it for 1.2 miles, then keep slightly left onto Cole Run Road for about 4.3 miles. The agency cautions that the site is reached by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not suit some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. No table, no toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
